upstreamEvidence.behavior: Roboto Mono, base 12px at100% code zoom, no minimap, no wrap, line highlight; upstream line height1.5 and 6px scrollbars.
Shared dirty/save/undo/redo, clean disk reconciliation versus dirty external conflict, explicit force save/reload.
Upstream UTF-8 preview (max2MiB) and UTF-8 write with expected-mtime conflict guard; native UTF16/EOL preservation is an intentional data-safety improvement.

implemented: QPlainTextEdit-derived code editor and visible line-number gutter
Roboto Mono12px base, local50–200% zoom shortcuts
Basic lexical syntax highlighting selected by filename; no LSP claims
Find/replace with case/whole-word/regex options and single-action undo
UTF8 with/without BOM, UTF16LE/BE with BOM; original BOM, trailing newline, LF/CRLF/CR/mixed/Unicode line delimiters retained
NBSP retained via QTextDocument::toRawText instead of lossy toPlainText
Invalid encoding/UTF32/NUL payloads rejected without replacing open buffer
QSaveFile atomic commit with content-byte optimistic conflict check, not mtime only
External watcher adopts clean changes; dirty conflict retains buffer with explicit reload/overwrite/recreate
Save errors and missing directories preserve unsaved edits
Save/Discard/Cancel close contract for MainWindow integration

verification.environment: Qt6.11.2 static, GCC16.2, Windows11, native windows QPA
verification.results: 26 QtTest passes, 0 failures, 0 skips (includes12 encoding/EOL rows and init/cleanup); audit/editor-tests.txt
verification.visual: audit/native-editor-preview.png rendered without showing a window or interacting with the user's app. It precedes a final13px→12px source-backed font-size correction.
fixesFoundByAudit: Lone UTF16 surrogate decoder acceptance now explicitly rejected
Partial undo of a minority newline previously lost its delimiter metadata; regression added
QTextDocument regex find requires explicit case flag; find/replace match case now covered
Indent insertion at column0 must not copy indentation after cursor
Line-number gutter geometry now grows when document crosses digit counts

limits: This is an initial native source editor, not full Monaco parity.
No language server, semantic diagnostics/completion, multi-cursor, folding, code actions, rich Markdown/SVG preview, image/media preview or editable diff view implemented here.
Syntax coloring is lexical and covers only a basic set of common constructs; complex embedded/multiline language grammars remain.
Default QTextDocument line metrics and native scrollbars do not yet reproduce upstream18px line height/6px scrollbar styling exactly.
File-size limit20MiB; large-file performance not benchmarked.
No arbitrary legacy encoding detection or UTF32 editing.
Atomic commit prevents partial writes; content check is optimistic and does not provide interprocess compare-and-swap against an external writer racing between check and commit.
Current CodeEditor text extraction/reconciliation hashes source text to track line metadata; performance for sustained edits of large documents needs profiling.
Full upstream visual parity and integration closure tests remain with parent integrated build.
